en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a mountain spa resort with several large villa-style buildings among coniferous forest. A path with two people walking is in the foreground, with fences and utility poles leading toward the complex. The reverse side carries printed Romanian and Russian captions identifying Borsec and a CCS rest house, a Romanian postage stamp, a 1957 cancellation, and a handwritten message and address.
